state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`: Stage 6 (no list maps PHP to Novis). File sets 1 and 2 are on disk, and file set 3 is half done.** ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

On disk: `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md`, `data/spec/php-migration.json` and its schema, `tools/data/php-builtins.txt`, `tools/dump-php-builtins.php`, `bun nv migration`, Part D of `docs/novis.md`, the CI job `migration-table`, the wrap's migration gate and the two migration tests in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/spec_registry_coverage.rs` (with their ratchet file) are all gone. The `Replaces` column left every table in `docs/spec/01-core-library.md`, `website/config/spec-overrides.mjs`, `website-core.ts`, `core.json`, `MethodSignature.astro` and the proofs roster (`Entry.twin`). The five PHP-name rules and `ide/three-of-four-item-shapes-insert-nothing` are deleted. `core-api/removals` keeps its four reasons and no longer claims a per-name list. Frozen records lost their links to the deleted files, the way commit b40ffee55 did it: each link became its text.

All five Stage 6 checks should pass at this commit (the two `git grep` checks were run by hand and found nothing).
